title: The Absolute Equality Mural
bio: Houston-based artist Reginald C. Adams is known for creating powerful public art that celebrates history, healing, and community. In Galveston, he led the creation of the Absolute Equality mural, a landmark tribute to Juneteenth and the ongoing journey toward freedom and equality.
desc: The Absolute Equality mural in Galveston honors the birthplace of Juneteenth and celebrates the ongoing pursuit of freedom, justice, and equality.

title: Greetings from Galveston
bio: Gabriel Prusmack is a Galveston-based artist known for his bright colors, bold designs, and joyful public art. His work often blends playful imagery, identity, and island spirit, helping bring color and creativity to public spaces throughout Galveston.
desc: Greetings From Galveston mural is one of the island’s most recognizable photo spots. Painted in the style of a vintage postcard, the mural welcomes visitors with colorful letters that celebrate Galveston’s beaches, landmarks, history, and coastal character.

title: Postoffice Street Mural Collection
desc: The Postoffice Mural Collection began as Galveston’s Kindness Mural, a colorful reminder to lead with compassion and community spirit. Over time, it has evolved into a quarterly rotating mural project where local and visiting artists showcase their creativity during ArtWalk. Now led by local artist Justin Lopez, the collection continues to bring fresh energy, new voices, and ever-changing public art to Postoffice Street.

title: I Love Galveston Mural
bio: Gabriel Prusmack is a Texas muralist based in Galveston whose work is known for its vibrant color, playful imagination, and large-scale public art. His murals bring energy to everyday spaces and help turn city walls into joyful landmarks.
desc: The I Love Galveston mural at 24th and The Strand is a colorful celebration of island life. Filled with playful sea creatures and a bold red heart, it has become a fun photo stop that captures Galveston’s coastal charm and community pride.

title: Stay Beach Box Mural
bio: Carlos Villasana, also known as Loz Paints, is a Galveston-based muralist and art educator. His work brings bold color, public art, and creative energy to local spaces, transforming walls and surfaces into eye-catching pieces that reflect the spirit of the island.
desc: Stay Beach Box Mural brings a bright coastal splash to 25th and Market Street. Painted in spray paint, the mural adds color and island personality to the side of Stay Beach Box and helps welcome visitors into Galveston’s growing public art scene.

title: Mermaids
bio: Mary Ruth Brown of Mistress Mary Studios is a multidisciplinary Galveston artist whose work spans murals, painting, ceramics, sculpture, costume design, performance, and mixed media
desc: The SOMA Tattoo Mermaid Mural at MarMo Plaza brings a dreamy, coastal energy to Market Street. Featuring mystical mermaid imagery, the mural reflects Galveston’s connection to the Gulf, imagination, and creative self-expression, making it a colorful stop in the downtown arts district

title: Market Street Station
bio: Justin Lopez is a Galveston-based mural artist known for creating vibrant, detailed artwork inspired by the landscapes, wildlife, and coastal character of the Gulf Coast. Raised in Galveston, his connection to the island’s natural environment strongly influences his use of bold colors and recognizable local imagery.
desc: The Market Station mural brings the energy of the venue to life through colorful imagery featuring a vintage streetcar, billiard balls and other playful details. The mural celebrates the building’s connection to historic downtown.

title: Star Drug Store Coca Cola  Mural
desc: Tucked into the alley beside Star Drug Store, the Coca-Cola mural adds a nostalgic splash of color to one of Galveston’s most historic downtown landmarks. Its vintage-style lettering and classic imagery reflect the building’s long history while creating hidden charm.

title: Beachy Vibes Only
bio: Whitney Hayden is a Texas muralist and the founder of Murals by Whitney. She is known for creating colorful, uplifting and often interactive artwork for businesses, public spaces and private clients. Her murals frequently feature playful imagery, bright colors and positive messages designed to bring joy to the community and encourage visitors to stop and take photographs.
desc: The “Beachy Vibes Only” mural celebrates Galveston’s relaxed island spirit with bright colors and playful coastal imagery. Created by Whitney Hayden, the mural provides a cheerful and memorable photo opportunity for visitors exploring downtown Galveston. It is one of two murals Hayden created at the former Texas Tail Distillery.

title: Huli Huli Hut
bio: Justin Lopez is a Galveston-based mural artist known for creating colorful, large-scale works inspired by the island’s coastal culture, wildlife and local businesses. His murals can be found throughout Galveston and often combine bold colors, detailed imagery and a strong sense of place.
desc: Created for Huli Huli Hut’s new location at 504 25th Street, the mural captures the restaurant’s lively tropical atmosphere with bright colors and playful island-inspired imagery.

title: Surfer Greetings from Galveston
bio: Carlos Villasana is a Galveston artist, muralist, and art educator known for colorful public art that celebrates creativity and island life. His work can be seen throughout the community, including downtown murals and Galveston’s Turtles About Town project.

title: Carriage Haus
bio: Gabriel Prusmack is a Galveston-born artist and muralist known for his vibrant, graffiti influenced work created with aerosol, stencils, and bold color. His murals and mixed media pieces often explore joy, freedom, nature, and identity, bringing a playful and recognizable energy to public spaces throughout Galveston and beyond.

title: Abstraction
bio: Carlos Villasana is a Galveston artist, muralist, and art educator known for colorful public art that celebrates creativity and island life. His work can be seen throughout the community, including downtown murals and Galveston’s Turtles About Town project. Through both his artwork and teaching, Carlos contributes to Galveston’s vibrant and growing arts community.

title: Public & Cruise Parking
bio: Gabriel Prusmack is a Texas muralist based in Galveston whose work is known for its vibrant color, playful imagination, and large-scale public art. His murals bring energy to everyday spaces and help turn city walls into joyful landmarks.

title: Whispers of the Seen and Unseen
bio: Ibraim Nascimento is a Houston area artist whose work reflects a vibrant creative perspective shaped by culture, place, and personal expression. Through his art, he brings a distinctive voice to the local arts community and contributes to the rich diversity of Galveston’s creative landscape.

title: Hidden Koi Pond
bio: Derek Anderson is a longtime Galveston artist known for his distinctive work inspired by the island’s history, character, and culture. From murals and public art to mixed-media pieces, his work reflects a deep connection to the Galveston community.

title: Galveston Archways
bio: RAZ worked professionally for decades in painting, murals, sculpture, trompe l’oeil, animation, and digital art. His style is described as “Neo-photo-surrealism.”

title: Hazey Daze
bio: Derek Anderson is a longtime Galveston artist known for his distinctive work inspired by the island’s history, character, and culture. From murals and public art to mixed-media pieces, his work reflects a deep connection to the Galveston community.
